scene.text: Traditional Chinese ink-and-watercolour painting: confident dark ink-brush linework, loose expressive brushwork, soft bleeding colour washes, visible paper grain. Faces, hands and skin are built the same way as everything else — flat washes and visible brushstrokes, edges left unresolved where the brush lifted. A medium close-up shot of the rear three-quarter section of a black stretch limousine in motion, with no human subjects visible. The vehicle is a long-body luxury sedan with chrome trim along the rocker panels, chrome multi-spoke wheels with white-wall tires, and a red tail lamp visible at the far left edge of the frame. The limousine's elongated side windows reflect warm amber/orange light in the rearmost pane and a vivid blue glow—suggesting a city nightscape or interior lighting—in the forward passenger windows. The setting is a dark roadway at night with an indistinct dark background.
